decisions.reason: The flagship Abendbrotkäse was promoted on the home page and fits the core cheese range, so it is cheap to keep even though it has not been shown since 2020.
As a multi-variant line, it can be pruned variant by variant rather than abandoned, so keeping the core option open is still worthwhile despite little visibility.
The mild soft cheese rounds out the soft-cheese range at low cost, but its absence from the website since 2020 suggests limited value, so it stays under review.

After four years, this niche washed-rind cheese has shown no evidence of traction, so the uncertainty has largely resolved against it and its resources are better spent on the core business or new development.
